title: Cheetah
wikitext:
[[image:Cheetah2.png|thumb|]]
A species of big [[cat]] found in [[The Barrens]], the [[Badlands]], the [[Swamp of Sorrows]], and [[Thousand Needles]].  [[Druids]] can shapeshift into [[Travel Form]], which looks exactly like a '''cheetah'''. So far, although these [[mob]]s ''look like'' a cheetah, none of them are named as such.
